Special Branch,
December 31, 1940.

Czechoslovakian Refugees - Letter dated December 24, 1940
from Secretary & Commissioner General, S.M.C.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

In accordance with instructions received, Captain
V.G. TAUSSIG, Acting Military Delegate of the Czechoslovakian
Army in China, has been interviewed in respect of the issuing
of Immigration Certificates without prior reference to the
Jewish Committee.

Matters of registration, the issue of permits, depositing
of funds to ensure that immigrants do not become a public
burden, etc., etc., were touched upon and Captain TAUSSIG
promised his full co-operation in all details. Captain
TAUSSIG will work with the "inner committee" of the
Czechoslovak Circle which comprises Major STEPAN, Captain
TAUSSIG, Messrs. STEMBERA, URBANEK and LILLING. These
gentlemen will examine all applications for permits and if
approving of them will pass them to this office for final
consideration. All applications will be signed and counter-
signed by

(1) Major STEPAN and
(2) Mr. LILLING.

Captain TAUSSIG has no information at present of the
impending arrival in Shanghai of Czech refugees but he will
seek the assistance of this office as soon as he receives
information that the Czech refugees concerned desire to take
up residence in Shanghai.

I do not consider that there can be any objections to
these arrangements provided that registration of immigrants
is effected with S.M.Police upon arrival.

Certified true copy

特别处，
1940年12月31日。

捷克斯洛伐克难民 - 关于工部局总办兼秘书长1940年12月24日来信
---

根据所获指示，已就未经犹太委员会事先转介而签发入境证书一事，约谈了捷克斯洛伐克驻华军队代理军事代表 V.G. TAUSSIG 上尉。

会谈涉及登记事宜、许可证签发、存入资金以确保移民不成为公共负担等事项，TAUSSIG 上尉承诺在所有细节上给予充分合作。TAUSSIG 上尉将与捷克斯洛伐克团体的“内部委员会”协作，该委员会由 STEPAN 少校、TAUSSIG 上尉、STEMBERA 先生、URBANEK 先生和 LILLING 先生组成。上述人士将审查所有许可证申请，如予批准，则转交本办公室作最终审议。所有申请须由以下两人签署及副署：

(1) STEPAN 少校，以及
(2) LILLING 先生。

TAUSSIG 上尉目前尚无关于捷克难民即将抵达上海的消息，但一旦获悉相关捷克难民希望在上海定居，他将立即寻求本办公室的协助。

我认为，只要移民抵达时向上海公共租界警务处办理登记，对这些安排不应有任何异议。

核证无误副本

〔此处转录不清〕

REF. No. K. 38/3.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
REG. 5422 (H)
Council Chamber / 41
Date ____

ADMINISTRATION BUILDING

Shanghai, December 24. 19 40.

The Commissioner of Police.

Czechoslovakian Refugees.

I have had an enquiry from Captain V.G. Taussig
regarding the entry of Czechoslovakian refugees into Shanghai.
It is the wish that permits be issued without using the agency
of the Jewish Committee, in whose stead it is suggested that
the local Czechoslovakian Committee might function.

The matter might be dealt with on the lines of the
proposals regarding the entry of Polish refugees, referred to
in my letter of August 9 to the Polish Charge d'Affaires and
your report of September 17 (Reference D5422 (G)).

Perhaps you would be so good as to arrange for your
representative to interview Captain Taussig in this matter.

D. C. (Cr & Sp. Branch)
Please do so & let me have
a report in due course.
T.
（签名）
Commissioner of Police

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 27 DEC 1940）

Secretary & Commissioner General.

上海公共租界工部局
（印：上海公共租界工部局）

上海公共租界工部局
登记号 5422 (H)
议事厅 / 41
日期 ____

行政大厦

上海，1940年12月24日。

致警务处处长。

捷克斯洛伐克难民。

本人收到 V.G. Taussig 上尉关于捷克斯洛伐克难民进入上海的查询。其愿望是签发许可证时无需通过犹太委员会这一机构，并建议由当地捷克斯洛伐克委员会取而代之行使职能。

此事可参照本人8月9日致波兰代办函件及贵方9月17日报告（参考号 D5422 (G)）中提及的关于波兰难民入境的建议方案进行处理。

烦请安排贵方代表就此事项约谈 Taussig 上尉。

D. C. (刑事及特别处)
请照办，并适时向我提交报告。
T.
（签名）
警务处处长

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 处长办公室 / 1940年12月27日）

总办兼秘书长。
